title: US single release: Band On The Run by Paul McCartney and Wings | 1974
content:
Paul McCartney and Wings’ single ‘Band On The Run’ was released in the United States on 8 April 1974.

The single, with ‘Nineteen Hundred And Eighty-Five’ on the b-side, topped the US Billboard Hot 100.

In the UK, ‘Band On The Run’ was issued with ‘Zoo Gang’ on the flipside. It peaked at number three on the UK singles chart.
